2. The methylene group (CH2) connected to the hydroxyl - typically gives one peak
3. The CH in the ring (C=CH-N) - typically gives one peak
4. The NH in the ring - typically gives one peak

So there should be 4 different types of hydrogen atoms, resulting in 4 peaks in the 1H NMR spectrum.
